nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.ct_pet_v5.run
==================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.ct_pet_v5.run

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   CT-PET v5 pipeline master.

   Entry point for the whole CT-PET v5 pipeline (stages 1-3). Dispatches each
   stage either **locally** (in-process loop over subjects) or on **SGE** (one
   array job per subject; tasks = stages with ``-tc 1`` + done-markers). Stage 0
   is *not* part of this master — it is orchestrated by
   :mod:`nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.run_batch` and its ``jid`` can be forwarded here via
   ``--base-hold``.

   .. rubric:: Examples

   Local run for one subject, only stage 2::

       nvitk-pesa-fat-ctpet --batch 202602_Week4 --subjects PESA001         --stages stage2 --submit local

   Submit the full chain of every subject on the cluster::

       nvitk-pesa-fat-ctpet --batch 202602_Week4 --submit sge         --container /data3/BIOIT_IMAGE/Containers/gpu-pesa-fat_v2025.5.27.sif         --src-dir /path/to/nvitk/src

   The ``--base-hold`` flag should be set when a stage 0 job is already in
   queue, so every subject's array waits for its stage 0 sibling.

.. py:data:: log

.. py:data:: INPUT_SOURCE_CHOICES
   :value: ('paths', 'xnat')


.. py:data:: STAGE_MODULES
   :type:  dict[str, str]

.. py:function:: _local_runner(stage: str) -> Callable[Ellipsis, Any]

   Return the local ``run_subject`` callable for *stage*; raises ``ValueError`` for unknown stages.


.. py:function:: _stage_resources(stage: str, *, device: str = 'gpu') -> nvitk.cluster.sge.SgeResources

   Per-stage SGE resource request.

   Stage 1 always uses the GPU h_vmem config. When *device* is ``"gpu"``,
   every stage requests ``ngpu=SGE_NGPU`` (so stages 2/3 run on a GPU node
   too); when ``"cpu"``, every stage requests ``ngpu=SGE_CPU_NGPU``.


.. py:function:: _run_local(lay: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths.BatchLayout, subjects: list[str], stages_sel: list[str], *, backend: str, device: str, model_dir: pathlib.Path | None, overwrite: bool, exclude_ureter: bool = True) -> None

   Run the requested CT-PET v5 stages for every subject sequentially in-process, publishing stage-3
   results to the DB and aggregating the batch summary once stage-3 has run for any subject.


.. py:function:: _aggregate_stage3(lay: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths.BatchLayout, subjects: list[str]) -> pathlib.Path | None

   Concatenate per-subject stage-3 xlsx files into ``<batch>_SummaryCodebook.xlsx``.


.. py:function:: _build_python_cmd(stage: str, subject: str, lay: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths.BatchLayout, *, binds: nvitk.cluster.sge.SingularityBinds, backend: str, device: str, overwrite: bool, log_level: str, exclude_ureter: bool = True) -> str

   Build the ``python -m nvitk.pipes...stageX --batch ... --subject ...`` cmd.

   Uses *in-container* paths so the worker sees the bind-mounted locations:

   * ``--nifti-root``   -> ``binds.data``      (e.g. ``/PESAFat/data/``)
   * ``--results-root`` -> ``binds.output``    (e.g. ``/PESAFat/output/``)
   * ``--model-dir``    -> ``binds.models``    (e.g. ``/models/``)
   * ``--dicom-root``   is not actually used by stages 1-3, but we still set
     it to ``binds.data`` so :class:`BatchLayout` stays consistent.


.. py:function:: _cluster_paths(lay: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths.BatchLayout, container: pathlib.Path, src_dir: pathlib.Path) -> nvitk.cluster.sge.ClusterPaths

   Build the :class:`~nvitk.cluster.sge.ClusterPaths` (container/model/data/output roots) for
   submitting CT-PET v5 SGE jobs from *lay*.


.. py:function:: submit_subject_chain(subject: str, lay: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths.BatchLayout, stages_sel: list[str], *, container: pathlib.Path, src_dir: pathlib.Path, backend: str = 'cupy', device: str = 'gpu', model_dir: pathlib.Path | None = None, overwrite: bool = False, base_hold: str | None = None, dry_run: bool = False, log_level: str = 'INFO', emit: TextIO | None = None, exclude_ureter: bool = True) -> list[str]

   Submit one CT-PET v5 SGE array job for a *single* subject.

   Array tasks are the selected stages in order (``-tc 1`` + done-markers).
   *base_hold* is applied to the whole array (e.g. the subject's stage-0 jid).

   Returns ``[jid]`` (one array job id) so batch aggregate/QC can hold on it.


.. py:function:: _run_sge(lay: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths.BatchLayout, subjects: list[str], stages_sel: list[str], *, backend: str, device: str, model_dir: pathlib.Path | None, overwrite: bool, container: pathlib.Path, src_dir: pathlib.Path, base_hold: str | None, dry_run: bool, log_level: str, emit: TextIO | None = None, exclude_ureter: bool = True) -> dict[str, list[str]]

   Submit an SGE job chain (or array) for the requested stages for every subject; returns
   ``{subject: [job_id, ...]}``.


.. py:function:: main(batch: str, subjects: str | None, stages: str, submit: str, base_hold: str | None, dicom_root: pathlib.Path | None, nifti_root: pathlib.Path | None, results_root: pathlib.Path | None, input_source: str, xnat_config: pathlib.Path | None, xnat_session: str | None, backend: str, device: str, model_dir: pathlib.Path | None, overwrite: bool, container: pathlib.Path | None, src_dir: pathlib.Path | None, dry_run: bool, emit_script: pathlib.Path | None, log_level: str, debug: bool, exclude_ureter: bool = True) -> None

   CT-PET v5 pipeline master (local or SGE dispatch).
